commitMessage:
Improve Indonesian wording across the app

- Fix 90 awkward or wrong labels: driver fields were 'Antarmuka',
  'Diperlukan/Ekstra' become 'Wajib/Tambahan', 'Grup Induk' for the
  parent group, Online/Offline device status, clearer command names
  (Blokir / Buka Blokir Mesin), report column names and typos
  (Pengindetifikasi, Kadaluarsa, HIdupkan, DIam)
- Billing and consent pages no longer hard-code English labels
